def floodFill(image, sr, sc, newColor):
    if not image or image[sr][sc] == newColor:
        return image
    
    rows, cols = len(image), len(image[0])
    start_color = image[sr][sc]
    
    def dfs(r, c):
        if r < 0 or r >= rows or c < 0 or c >= cols or image[r][c] != start_color:
            return
        image[r][c] = newColor
        dfs(r + 1, c)
        dfs(r - 1, c)
        dfs(r, c + 1)
        dfs(r, c - 1)
    
    dfs(sr, sc)
    return image
